DATO' SERI IDRIS BIN JUSOH

Menteri Pendidikan Tinggi

PRIVATE HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ACT 1996

PRIVATE HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PERMIT TO TEACH)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 88 of the

Private Higher Educational Institutions Act 1996 [Act 555], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Private Higher Educational

Institutions (Permit to Teach) (Amendment) Regulations 2017.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 28 November 2017.

Substitution of regulation 3

2. The Private Higher Educational Institutions (Permit to Teach) Regulations 1997

[P.U. (A) 547/1997], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these

Regulations, are amended by substituting for regulation 3 the following regulation:

"Application for

 permit to teach.

3. An application for a permit to teach in a private higher

educational institution shall be made to the Registrar General in

Form A as specified in the First Schedule and shall be accompanied

by—

(a) any document as may be determined by the

Registrar General; and

(b) the fee as specified in the Second Schedule.".

Amendment of regulation 4

3. Regulation 4 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) in subregulation (1), by substituting for the words "in the form prescribed in

the Second Schedule" the words "in Form B as specified in the

First Schedule";

(b) by substituting for subregulation (2) the following subregulation:

"(2) A permit to teach shall be valid until revoked under section 52 of

the Act unless such permit is subject to any period of validity as may be

determined by the Registrar General."; and

(c) by substituting for subregulation (3) the following subregulation:

"(3) Notwithstanding subregulation (2), a permit to teach for a teacher

who is not a citizen of Malaysia, other than a permanent resident, shall be

valid for a period not exceeding the period of an employment pass issued to

the teacher by the Director General of Immigration.".

Amendment of regulation 6

4. Regulation 6 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) in subregulation (1), by substituting for the words "The duration of a permit

to teach" the words "Where a permit to teach is subject to a period of

validity, the period of such permit";

(b) by substituting for subregulation (2) the following subregulation:

"(2) The application for an extension under subregulation (1) shall be

made to the Registrar General in Form C as specified in the First Schedule

and shall be accompanied by—

(a) any document as may be determined by the Registrar

General; and

(b) the fee as specified in the Second Schedule.";

(c) by substituting for subregulation (3) the following subregulation:

"(3) Where the Registrar General extends the period of a permit to

teach, the Registrar General shall endorse on a duplicate of such permit the

new period of the permit to teach.";

(d) by substituting for subregulation (4) the following subregulation:

"(4) An extension of the period of a permit to teach shall be valid until

revoked under section 52 of the Act unless such extension is subject to any

period of validity as may be determined by the Registrar General."; and

(e) by inserting after subregulation (4) the following subregulation:

"(5) Notwithstanding subregulation (4), an extension of the period of

a permit to teach for a teacher who is not a citizen of Malaysia, other

than a permanent resident, shall be valid for a period not exceeding the

period of an employment pass issued to the teacher by the

Director General of Immigration.".

Substitution of regulation 7

5. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 7 the

following regulation:

"Changes of

 particulars in

 permit to teach.

7. (1) If there is any changes of the particulars in the permit to

teach after its issuance, the teacher to whom the permit to teach has

been issued shall apply to the Registrar General for the change of

such particulars in his permit to teach in Form D as specified in the

First Schedule and such application shall be accompanied by the fee

as specified in the Second Schedule.

(2) Where the Registrar General approves the application

under subregulation (1), the Registrar General shall issue a new

permit to teach to the teacher in Form B as specified in the

First Schedule.

(3) Any changes made to a permit to teach as approved

under subregulation (2) shall be recorded by the private higher

educational institution in the register of teachers referred to in

subsection 51(7) of the Act.

(4) No person shall make any changes to a permit to teach

issued by the Registrar General except by or with the approval of the

Registrar General.

(5) Any person who contravenes subregulation (4) commits

an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding

ten thousand ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding

one month or to both.".

Deletion of regulation 8

6. The principal Regulations are amended by deleting regulation 8.

Amendment of regulation 9

7. Subregulation 9(2) of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) by substituting for the words "in Form ‘C' in the First Schedule" the words

"to the Registrar General in Form E as specified in the First Schedule";

(b) in paragraph (b), by deleting the word "and" at the end of the paragraph;

(c) by substituting for paragraph (c) the following paragraph:

"(c) the fee as specified in the Second Schedule; and"; and

(d) by inserting after paragraph (c) the following paragraph:

"(d) any other document as may be determined by the Registrar General.".

Substitution of regulation 10

8. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 10 the

following regulation:

"Prohibition on

 teacher.

10. (1) A teacher shall not teach—

(a) a field of study exceeding the level of study stated in

the permit to teach issued to him; or

(b) a field of study other than the field of study stated in

the permit to teach issued to him.

(2) Any teacher who contravenes paragraph (1)(a) or (b)

commits an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not

exceeding ten thousand ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not

exceeding one month or to both.".

New regulation 11

9. The principal Regulations are amended by inserting after regulation 10 the

following regulation:

"Prohibition on

 private higher

 educational

 institution.

11. (1) A private higher educational institution shall not allow or

direct a teacher to teach—

(a) a field of study exceeding the level of study stated in

the permit to teach issued to him; or

(b) a field of study other than the field of study stated in

the permit to teach issued to him.

(2) Any private higher educational institution which

contravenes paragraph (1)(a) or (b) commits an offence and shall, on

conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding ten thousand ringgit or to

imprisonment for a term not exceeding one month or to both.".

Substitution of First Schedule

10. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:
